events.title: Kemper (KMPR): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q4 Earnings?
events.body: Kemper’s stock price has taken a beating over the past six months, shedding 42.3% of its value and falling to $30.49 per share. This was partly driven by its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.
